verdict.rationale: Scheduling recurring workflows is a fair question for an AI meeting-notes product, but the evidence shows no user-configurable recurring job or schedule. Recipes are reusable prompts run on demand with a click. Overnight pre-meeting briefs, post-meeting follow-up drafts, HubSpot folder sync and transcript auto-deletion are fixed built-in or event-triggered behaviors. Zapier automation is a third-party platform, not Granola's own scheduler, so none of these count toward the story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
